title: Practitioner Insights on Fairness Requirements in the AI Development Life Cycle: An Interview Study
findings: Religion is recognized by AI practitioners as a sensitive attribute that can be a source of bias. However, the methods for addressing this are often informal and inconsistent. One practitioner, for instance, described a simple, ad-hoc test for fairness by comparing a chatbot's responses to test cases from Christian and Muslim users.

measurement_description: The paper does not conduct a benchmark. It reports on an interview study with AI practitioners. One participant provided an anecdotal example of a fairness test: giving a chatbot the same query from Christian and Muslim perspectives to check if the results were equal.
